label: Stats → Players lists MFL's own players at their MFL positions, with status chips (this week's NFL injury report + IR/PUP from MFL, with update times), Usage (offensive snaps, Snap% over his team's snaps in his games, targets) on the list and in the game log, Boom/Bust with availability, the team red-zone pass rate labelled as the team's, and EPA on box-score plays.
